summary.headline: Katarchē Questions About Ships
summary.text: Katarchē examples concerning fear of a ship: an Athenian question interpreted through the lot of fortune, planetary rulers, houses, terms, and Dorotheus’s chapter, with predictions of danger, loss, travel, animals, and recovered objects; a second case from Smyrna begins concerning a ship expected from Alexandria.
